historical_commentary.text: Only the teaser paragraph survives for this note, which compares the older 3.x-era 'linked list' technique to the new native hierarchical list feature introduced in 4D V6 — a genuinely new UI/data-structure capability at the time. Hierarchical lists remain a supported 4D concept today, though the specific V6-era creation steps described are dated relative to modern list/array and Design mode tooling.
related_updates: 4D still supports hierarchical lists, but the creation/editing tooling and surrounding language commands have evolved substantially since V6 (1997)
The older 3.x 'linked list' workaround technique described for comparison is obsolete now that hierarchical lists are a native, built-in feature
